notes: Created comprehensive implementation plan for 15 change requests in _agent_docs/specifications/change-requests/. Used writing-plans skill workflow: (1) read all 15 CR files, (2) called world-review subagent for UX impact, risk analysis, grouping suggestions, edge cases, and prioritization, (3) called explore subagent for full codebase architecture research, (4) called planner subagent to design phased implementation with test plans. Plan organizes CRs into 5 phases: Phase 1 (Quick Wins: docs, saliency timeout, keyboard shortcuts), Phase 2 (UI Polish: bg opacity, color names, export format), Phase 3 (Major UX: collapsible sidebar, diagonal angle, crop overlay shapes, hex size/DnD), Phase 4 (Advanced: multi-touch gestures), Phase 5 (Refactoring: DOM IDs, legacy extraction, callback pattern, hex gutter OCP). Each phase includes unit tests, E2E tests, priority ordering, and known behaviors.
